title.en: An Act Creating a Barangay National High School in Barangay Alegria, Municipality of Murcia, Province of Negros Occidental, to Be Known as the Barangay Alegria National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Barangay Alegria Quốc gia tại Barangay Alegria, Đô thị Murcia, Tỉnh Negros Occidental, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Barangay Alegria แห่งชาติ ในบารังไกย์ Alegria เทศบาล Murcia จังหวัด Negros Occidental และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

text.en: There shall be established a barangay national high school in Barangay Alegria, Municipality of Murcia, Province of Negros Occidental, to be known as the Barangay Alegria National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act is hereby authorized to be appropriated in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
